Step by step KOHBAR Painting in Madhubani style (Part - 1). Lesson - 20
The Kohbar Ghar is the room in which the KOHBAR painting has traditionally been done in the Maithil culture to bless a newlywed couple.
The central theme of the Kohbar painting is love and prosperity.
Originally the painting depictes a symbolic image of the lotus, the bamboo grove, fishes, birds and snakes in union. These images represents fertility and love of life.
